description: Search IRCC's high-wage occupation list (in effect November 3, 2026; 186 NOC 2021 codes) by job title words or NOC code. Returns each match's level (2×, 1.5× or 1.3× the average median wage) and the CRS points it earns. An occupation that isn't listed earns no high-wage or job offer points.

query.description: Job title words or a NOC code, e.g. 'software engineer' or '72201'

name: find_high_wage_occupation
title: Find a high-wage occupation
